gold_assessment.reasoning: Gold: numbness of the left arm for 2 weeks. Generated CC-001: numbness and tingling in the left arm and fingers. The core complaint of left arm numbness is present; duration (2 weeks) is picked up in HPI-001, not CC, but overall captured across generated facts.

Gold: mild weakness when holding objects and playing the piano. Generated HPI-003: mild weakness in left arm that affects piano playing. Weakness affecting piano is covered, but weakness when holding objects is omitted.

Gold: tingling and numbness in the shoulder. Generated facts mention tingling and numbness in left arm and fingers, but do not mention the shoulder specifically. Symptom type is covered, location (shoulder) is omitted.

Gold: numbness localized to the front side of the hand. Generated HPI-002: tingling in 2nd–4th fingers on palm side of the left hand. Palm side corresponds to front side of the hand; coverage is present with added finger detail.

Gold: visual disturbance in the left peripheral field lasting 20 minutes 2 weeks ago. Generated PMH-001 and ASM-003/004: transient left eye vision loss (~20 min). Duration and left-sided visual disturbance are captured; however, gold locates it in the left peripheral field and as part of HPI, while generated frames it as entire left eye and in PMH/assessment. So content is only partially aligned.

Gold: numbness involves left 2nd, 3rd, 4th fingers. Generated HPI-002: tingling in 2nd, 3rd, and 4th fingers on palm side of left hand. Same digits and side; generated adds palm detail but preserves gold content.
Gold: massage and warm baths did not relieve symptoms. No generated fact mentions massage, warm baths, or lack of relief from these measures.
Gold: patient reports headaches. No generated fact states that the patient has or reports headaches; only monitoring for headache is mentioned in the plan.

Gold: vomiting for 2 weeks over a month ago, starting after a party. Generated SH-002: recent episode of heavy drinking, but no mention of vomiting, 2-week duration, or temporal relation to the party. Only the context of heavy drinking is loosely reflected, so vomiting specifics are omitted.
Gold: patient takes ibuprofen. Generated MED-001: patient takes ibuprofen. Direct match.
Gold: patient takes vitamin D. Generated MED-002: patient takes vitamin D. Direct match.

Gold: patient takes iron tablets. Generated MED-004: patient is non-compliant with prescribed iron supplements. Captures that iron is prescribed but changes status from taking to being non-compliant, so taking is not fully supported.
Gold: patient takes melatonin. Generated MED-003: patient uses melatonin occasionally. Indicates use of melatonin, but modifies frequency; core medication use is captured.
Gold: father has hypothyroidism and autoimmune disorders. Generated FH-001: father with hypothyroidism and autoimmune issues. Equivalent information.
Gold: mother has diabetes, high cholesterol, and high blood pressure. Generated FH-002: mother with T2DM, HTN, dyslipidemia. These map directly to DM, high BP, and high cholesterol.

Gold: patient recently started boxing lessons. Generated HPI-005: course of symptoms started with boxing classes. Boxing activity is mentioned and temporally linked to symptoms, but not explicitly as 'recent start' for physical activity. Activity is covered, some nuance omitted.

Gold: multiple sclerosis is being considered and needs to be ruled out. Generated ASM-004: MS is being considered as a cause of transient left eye vision loss, and PLAN-002: consider brain imaging to rule out MS. Consideration and rule-out by imaging are present; linkage specifically to 'needs to be ruled out' and to the whole presentation vs just vision loss is only partially aligned.
Gold: arrange an urgent neurology review. Generated PLAN-001: urgent neurology referral for further evaluation. Equivalent plan.

Gold: specific A&E advice for progressing arm/leg weakness, vomiting, visual disturbances, or fits. Generated PLAN-003: monitor for progression of symptoms (weakness, headache, visual changes). It mentions monitoring but does not include instruction to go to A&E, omits vomiting and fits, and adds headache. So follow-up advice is only partially reflected.
Gold: patient denies neck pain. Generated HPI-004: patient denies neck pain. Same information, though in a different section label.
Gold: patient denies seizures or fits. No generated fact documents denial of seizures/fits.
Gold: patient denies weakness elsewhere and gait is normal. No generated fact mentions absence of weakness elsewhere or normal gait.

gen_assessment.reasoning: Gold CC-001: numbness of left arm for 2 weeks. Generated adds tingling and includes fingers. Numbness in left arm is supported; tingling and finger involvement are additions beyond gold.

Gold CC-001: left arm numbness for 2 weeks. Generated HPI-001: 2-week history of numbness in L arm that has worsened over time. Duration and location are supported; 'worsened over time' is an added detail not present in gold.

Gold HPI-003: numbness on the front side of the hand; HPI-005: numbness in left 2nd–4th fingers. Generated: tingling in 2nd–4th fingers on palm side of left hand. Location (palm/front) and digits are supported; tingling (vs numbness only) is an addition, not contradicted.

Gold HPI-001: mild weakness when holding things and playing the piano. Generated: mild weakness in left arm that affects piano playing. Weakness and its impact on piano are supported; explicit mention of weakness when holding other objects is omitted.
Both state that patient denies neck pain; directly aligned, though labeled under different sections.

Gold HPI-004: visual disturbance in left peripheral field lasting 20 minutes 2 weeks ago. Generated: recent viral illness with transient left eye vision loss (~20 min). Duration and left-sided visual symptom are consistent; representing it as entire eye vision loss and tying it to a recent viral illness and PMH are additions not in gold.
Both document ibuprofen use; directly matches gold.
Both document vitamin D use; directly matches gold.
Gold: patient takes melatonin (no frequency). Generated: uses melatonin occasionally. Use is supported; 'occasional' is an added qualifier, not contradicted.

Gold MED-003: patient takes iron tablets (implies taking). Generated: patient is non-compliant with prescribed iron supplements (implies not taking as prescribed). This changes adherence status and conflicts with a straightforward interpretation of 'takes'.
Both indicate father has hypothyroidism and autoimmune disorders/issues; wording is equivalent.
Gold mother: diabetes, high cholesterol, high BP. Generated: T2DM, dyslipidemia, HTN. Same conditions with more specific terminology.
Gold social history only mentions boxing lessons; there is no mention of alcohol use. Occasional alcohol consumption is new information, not supported by gold but not contradicted.
Recent heavy drinking episode is not present in gold facts; gold only mentions a party related to vomiting but not heavy drinking. This is added detail.
Gold facts include no physical exam section at all. The statement that no physical exam findings are documented is not derivable from gold and is thus an addition.
Assessment including left arm numbness and tingling is consistent with symptoms but gold assessment only mentions r/o MS, not symptom-based assessment items. This is an added assessment detail.
Gold does not state that boxing exacerbates left arm numbness/tingling or that the etiology is 'possibly neurologic' in the assessment. These are new interpretive details.

Gold HPI-004: visual disturbance in left peripheral field for 20 minutes. Generated ASM-003: assessment includes transient vision loss in left eye. A left-sided transient visual issue is supported, but labeling it as eye vision loss (vs peripheral field disturbance) and formally including it as an assessment problem are additions.

Gold ASM-001: MS is being considered and needs to be ruled out (no specific symptom linkage). Generated: MS considered as cause of transient left eye vision loss. Consideration of MS is supported; linking it specifically to the eye symptom is an added detail.
Gold does not mention a recent viral illness in the assessment. Generated frames recent viral illness as possibly contributing; this is new and not supported by gold facts.
Gold: urgent neurology review. Generated: urgent neurology referral for further evaluation. Same plan content.

Gold ASM-001: MS is to be ruled out, but no specific modality mentioned. Generated: consider brain imaging to rule out MS. The intent to rule out MS is supported; the use of brain imaging is an added plan detail.

Gold FU-001: explicit instruction to attend A&E if progressing weakness, vomiting, visual disturbances, or fits. Generated: monitor for progression of weakness, headache, visual changes. Monitoring for progression of weakness and visual changes is supported conceptually, but lacks the A&E action, adds headache, and omits vomiting and fits; therefore only partially reflects the gold follow-up guidance.
